notes.title: Update #1: New Demo Content
notes.content:
[p]The first demo content update is here. We've added new Combat Arts, Ascensions, Equipment, Quests and Conduits. Also, Boss Fights have been tweaked be less spongey, but more challenging overall. In addition, we've worked on general balance changes and more clarity within the UI for an improved new player experience.[/p][h3]2 New Ascensions[/h3][list][*][p][b]Arcane Trickster[/b] Ascension for the Outlander Origin which specializes in elemental and magic damage types.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death Knight[/b] Ascension for the Soldier Origin which specializes in Death damage.  We also added 4 new pieces of equipment to accompany these Ascensions, with stats that help flesh out the builds and add flavor. You can find them in Equipment boxes during a run after completing the required prerequisites.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459921/738ca9ddc80e6cfa2926714174fb0799a93c3200.png"][/img][/p][h3]6 New Death Ritual Combat Arts[/h3][list][*][p]Skull Crow[/p][/*][*][p]Cauldron of Bats[/p][/*][*][p]Death Rancor[/p][/*][*][p]Spirit Lance[/p][/*][*][p]Summon Skeleton[/p][/*][*][p]Death Scythe[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459921/1c423dbe3800f804d6258dd05400453f9a578c81.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We also added a new Accessory - The Grave's Charm which gives you the Death type Affinity, this is also found in Equipment boxes during a run.[/i][/p][h3]3 New Conduits[/h3][p][i]We don't want to give these away entirely, but we will say one of them uses the Astral damage mod, one includes the Soldier starting skill, Punishing Slam, and the third to discover.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Summon Singularity[/p][/*][*][p]Ground Tremor[/p][/*][*][p]Grave Sword[/p][/*][/list][h3]1 New Modification[/h3][list][*][p]Focused Channeling - for longer cast times when using Death Rancor and future channeled Combat Arts.[/p][/*][/list][h3]User Experience Improvements and Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Playing in higher difficulty gives more meta currency from defeating the boss at the end of the sage. The multiplier is be displayed over the door before entering the portal to the stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Base gold value increased to 100 for gold bags given as boss rewards and destructible loot.[/p][/*][*][p]Scattershot Modification has been removed from the game. Instead, most Combat Arts will gain a chance for a bonus projectile as the Proficiency is upgraded during a run.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sage, Blacksmith, and Codex are now visible when you play the game for the first time, allowing you to see the Quest log at the Codex before your first run.[/p][/*][*][p]When using Keyboard and Mouse, all key input notifiers (such as the Interact button over Shrines and NPCs) now have a white background for better readability. [/p][/*][*][p]When ranking up a Proficiency level (Apprentice through Legendary) under "Next Proficiency Stats" you will now only see the stats that will be added when you rank up, instead of showing the total stats gained thus far.[/p][/*][*][p]Aim smoothing on controllers has been improved to be more responsive.'[/p][/*][*][p]Changed run outcome screen to use "B" controller button to close for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]There is now overhead text when picking up certain resources during a run, such as Reroll cubes, Codex currency, and Parchment used for purchasing Combat Arts. [/p][/*][*][p]Hurtbox adjustments for some enemies to make them a bit easier to hit with some of the more precise combat arts.[/p][/*][*][p]Evade cooldown proficiency percentages corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Consecrate Ground Conduit upgrade percentages corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]EXP bar now updates correctly after leveling. [/p][/*][*][p]Death Flame conduit has been renamed Funeral Pyre and received a buff to make it more powerful.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience Gain Trait would cause crazy leveling was fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed problem with difficulty level 3 bonus objectives never completing.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated text prompts on equipment display screen to better explain the process of gear creation and upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with weird timer display before the stage would officially start.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459921/783510b0795432aa5413ab27947c58d7ad710ebf.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459921/a743240ad94dbbd81cd13308f2daeb34a3b82b8c.png"][/img][/p]

In addition, we've worked on general balance changes and more clarity within the UI for an improved new player experience.

tags.feature: [b]Arcane Trickster[/b] Ascension for the Outlander Origin which specializes in elemental and magic damage types.

[b]Death Knight[/b] Ascension for the Soldier Origin which specializes in Death damage.  We also added 4 new pieces of equipment to accompany these Ascensions, with stats that help flesh out the builds and add flavor. You can find them in Equipment boxes during a run after completing the required prerequisites.
We also added a new Accessory - The Grave's Charm which gives you the Death type Affinity, this is also found in Equipment boxes during a run.
Summon Singularity
Ground Tremor
Grave Sword
Focused Channeling - for longer cast times when using Death Rancor and future channeled Combat Arts.

tags.balance_change: Playing in higher difficulty gives more meta currency from defeating the boss at the end of the sage. The multiplier is be displayed over the door before entering the portal to the stage.
Base gold value increased to 100 for gold bags given as boss rewards and destructible loot.
Scattershot Modification has been removed from the game. Instead, most Combat Arts will gain a chance for a bonus projectile as the Proficiency is upgraded during a run.

tags.feature: The Sage, Blacksmith, and Codex are now visible when you play the game for the first time, allowing you to see the Quest log at the Codex before your first run.
When using Keyboard and Mouse, all key input notifiers (such as the Interact button over Shrines and NPCs) now have a white background for better readability.

When ranking up a Proficiency level (Apprentice through Legendary) under "Next Proficiency Stats" you will now only see the stats that will be added when you rank up, instead of showing the total stats gained thus far.

tags.balance_change: Aim smoothing on controllers has been improved to be more responsive.'
Changed run outcome screen to use "B" controller button to close for consistency.

tags.feature: There is now overhead text when picking up certain resources during a run, such as Reroll cubes, Codex currency, and Parchment used for purchasing Combat Arts.

tags.balance_change: Hurtbox adjustments for some enemies to make them a bit easier to hit with some of the more precise combat arts.

tags.bug: Consecrate Ground Conduit upgrade percentages corrected.
EXP bar now updates correctly after leveling.

tags.balance_change: Death Flame conduit has been renamed Funeral Pyre and received a buff to make it more powerful.

tags.bug: Experience Gain Trait would cause crazy leveling was fixed.
Fixed problem with difficulty level 3 bonus objectives never completing.

tags.feature: Updated text prompts on equipment display screen to better explain the process of gear creation and upgrades.

tags.bug: Fixed issue with weird timer display before the stage would officially start.

notes.title: The Serpent and the Crow Demo is Now Available
notes.content:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459921/adc473cc9f366c1cd3828d314ddb384fb828bc06.png"][/img][/h2][p]Hello out there!
The two of us have been hard at work for the past year developing our take on a roguelite-survivor-like-action rpg and we're finally ready to share our Demo with you guys. We also plan on adding new content to this demo and updating it as we push toward full-release. Let us know if you have any feedback or suggestions.

Key Demo features:

[list]
[*]    The first Biome, a demon carnival swarming with jesters. Some of them will stab you in the gut.
[*]    2 Origins: the Outlander and the Soldier.
[*]    2 Ascensions: the Skirmisher and the Warrior.
[*]    3 different Skill Lines with a total of 16 skills to unlock and rank up through meta-progression.
[*]    Modifications that can be attached to skills that alter how they behave or change their damage types and stats.
[*]    Traits to improve core player stats.
[*]    Conduits which can be activated by choosing and ranking up two specific skills or Modifications that are connected to each other in the Destiny Wheel.
[*]  Equipment to collect during a run that you can craft and upgrade at the Blacksmith in the Tavern. (These change your characters appearance as well, we're pretty proud of that one.)
[*]  4 Difficulty Tiers and an Endless Mode
[*]  Full Steam Deck playability. 
[/list]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459921/fe477168b2b441790a5b11fea0be6080812b5e05.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459921/25e7c82d63e886164747dc970530f65f54a56aa0.png"][/img][/p]
